app.name: PaperPaw plugin workshop
start.title: Make your own plugin
start.lede: Say what your reader should do differently. An AI writes the plugin and shows it to you on an X4, an X4 Pro and a Boox, right here. No programming needed.
start.placeholder: For example: a calm dark look for reading at night, with wider margins.
start.hint: Write it as you would tell a friend. You can change everything later.
start.ideas.look.text: Margins, rows, headers, corners, light and dark.
start.ideas.look.prompt: A calmer look: wider margins, roomier rows and soft corners.
start.ideas.home.text: Which books, which widgets, in what order.
start.ideas.home.prompt: A home screen with a big clock, the book I am reading and the ones before it.
start.ideas.keys.text: What each button, tap and swipe does.
start.ideas.keys.prompt: Holding the page forward button should switch night mode on and off.
start.ideas.text.text: Larger letters everywhere, for tired eyes.
start.ideas.text.prompt: Larger text in books and menus, with more space between lines.
start.pay.title: Who pays for the AI?
start.pay.key.text: From console.anthropic.com. It stays in this browser and goes only to Anthropic. A plugin like these costs a few cents.
start.pay.key.label: Your Claude API key
start.pay.key.remember.help: Kept in this browser only. Leave it off on a shared computer.
start.pay.key.stronger: Use Claude Opus 5.5: more capable, about twice the price of Sonnet. Fixed for the plugin once started; only with your own key.
start.pay.quota.text: A monthly amount paperpaw.org pays, for authors whose application was accepted: Claude Haiku 5.5 for plugins without code, Claude Sonnet 5.5 for code.
start.pay.local.text: Install the workshop with Docker and use your own key there.
start.needs-key: Enter your Claude API key first.
workshop.saved: a plugin, saved in this browser
workshop.error.key: Anthropic did not accept the key. Check it and enter it again.
workshop.error.rate: Anthropic says too many requests at once. Wait a minute and send again.
workshop.error.network: Anthropic could not be reached. Check the connection and send again.
workshop.error.long: This conversation has become long, and longer ones cost more. Go on in a fresh one: your plugin's files and pictures stay, and the AI gets a short summary.
workshop.limit: It stopped after many steps. Tell it to go on, or what to change.
reader.stub: Preview without PaperPaw's emulator: its module is not built here (npm run emulator).
findings.title: What the checker says
findings.none: All well: nothing the checker found.
files.title: Files
workshop.checked: Checks: {n} to fix, given to the AI
provider.example: a recorded example: no key, no cost
start.example: Watch an example first, no key needed
workshop.example: This is a recorded example: the AI's answers are played back, the tools and the reader are real.
share.title: Share it in the store
share.lede: Everything the store asks for is filled in: the AI wrote the words, the screenshots come from the reader beside this. Change what you like, then send it.
share.name: Name
share.redraft.hint: The AI writes the words from your conversation. Your changes are replaced.
share.tags.hint: Up to five words, by commas, such as: dark, night
share.licence: What others may do with it
share.licence.CC0-1.0.text: Use, change and share it, no conditions. Best for looks and layouts.
share.licence.CC-BY-4.0.text: As above, as long as they say it came from you.
share.licence.MIT.text: Common for software: anything, keeping your copyright line.
share.licence.Apache-2.0.text: Like MIT, with rules on patents. PaperPaw's own licence.
share.licence.GPL-3.0-or-later.text: Changed copies must be shared under the GPL too.
share.shots.lede: Taken on the reader beside this: each device, and one at night.
share.shots.stub: Taken on the workshop's preview reader, which shows your plugin roughly. Once PaperPaw's real emulator is here, take them again.
share.pretend: A pretend store: nothing is sent anywhere. It shows the steps as they will be.
share.missing: Still needed before it can go:
share.problem.name: a name
share.problem.licence: what others may do with it
share.problem.tag: the tag "{tag}" in small letters, digits and hyphens
share.problem.checker: the checker's errors fixed (ask the AI in the conversation)
share.store.none: This workshop runs on your computer, without the store. Download it for the store and upload it at paperpaw.org/submit: the entry and the screenshots are inside.
share.store.closed: The store opens soon. Everything is ready: when it opens, you send it from this page. Until then you can download it for the store.
share.store.signed-out: To send it, sign in to paperpaw.org. You get an e-mail with a link; it brings you back here.
share.upload.hint: The store checks it as it checks every plugin. Nothing is public yet.
share.checked: The store checked it: all is well. Look at its page if you like, then send it.
share.checked.not: The store found something to fix. Its draft page says what.
share.draft-page: Open its draft in the store
share.sent.text: The moderators look at it, and you get an e-mail when it is in the store or if something needs changing.
share.error.draft: The AI could not write the entry: {message}
share.error.shots: The screenshots could not be taken: {message}
share.error.large: Left out, larger than the store takes: {files}
store.error.signed-out: You are signed out. Sign in again and send it once more.
store.error.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again and send it once more.
store.error.busy: The store is busy. Try again in a minute.
store.error.quota: Your submissions take more room than the store keeps per author.
store.error.too-many: That is enough submissions for today. Try again tomorrow.
store.error.refused: The store did not take it: {message}
store.error.network: The store could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
upload.drop: Drop it here: the AI can use it in the plugin or take ideas from it.
upload.refused.kind: {name} cannot be used: the workshop takes pictures (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, SVG), fonts (TTF, OTF) and texts.
upload.refused.large: {name} is larger than {mb} MB. Make it smaller first.
upload.refused.pixels: {name} has more than {mp} megapixels. Make it smaller first.
upload.refused.broken: {name} could not be read as a picture.
upload.refused.total: This plugin's uploads would take more than {mb} MB. Remove some in Files first.
files.uploads.text: Pictures and files you gave the workshop. They stay in this browser and are not part of the plugin: what the AI makes of them is, below.
files.uploads.none: Nothing yet. Add a picture beside the message field.
reader.asleep.none: This reader runs Android, which shows its own screen while it sleeps.
workshop.fresh: Go on in a fresh conversation
workshop.carried: A fresh conversation: the AI got a summary of the earlier one
workshop.error.cut: The answer reached its length limit before it was done. Tell it to go on.
workshop.error.billing: Your Anthropic account has no credit left. Add some in the Claude Console (Billing), then send again.
workshop.error.busy: Anthropic is overloaded right now. Wait a minute and send again.
workshop.error.server: Anthropic had a problem on its side. Send again in a moment.
workshop.error.reader: The reader is not ready yet. Wait a moment and try again.
upload.refused.count.one: This plugin has {n} upload already. Remove it in Files first.
upload.refused.count.other: This plugin has {n} uploads already. Remove some in Files first.
upload.refused.message.one: At most {n} at once: send this one first.
upload.refused.message.other: At most {n} at once: send these first.
upload.refused.shown.one: The AI can be shown only {n} more picture in this conversation. Leave some out, or go on in a fresh conversation.
upload.refused.shown.other: The AI can be shown only {n} more pictures in this conversation. Leave some out, or go on in a fresh conversation.
reader.label: The reader
start.ideas.tool: A small tool of my own
start.ideas.tool.text: A new screen or widget: a timer, a quote a day, a counter.
start.ideas.tool.prompt: A screen in the tools menu that shows a short quote, a different one each day.
start.code.text: a new screen, widget or tool. The AI writes Rust and builds it (Claude Sonnet 5.5: some cents to a dollar a plugin), which needs the builder (docker compose --profile code up).
workshop.download.ppn: The plugin built for the {device} the reader shows: its folder with code.ppn in it, for the plugins folder of the card (not signed yet).
workshop.ppn.failed: It did not build for the {device}. Ask the AI to build it and fix what the compiler says.
workshop.ppn.builder: The builder is not running, so there is no package for the X4 (docker compose --profile code up).
start.example.code: or one with code (needs the builder)
workshop.ppn.device: PaperPaw on the {device} takes plugins with code later. Show the X4 or the X4 Pro to download it for them.
start.pay.quota.none: Only in the workshop on paperpaw.org.
start.pay.quota.sign-in: Sign in at paperpaw.org to apply for it
start.pay.quota.waiting: Your application is waiting for an admin.
start.pay.quota.revoked: The quota was taken back from your account.
start.pay.quota.left: {left} of {budget} US dollars left this month (about {euros} euros).
start.pay.quota.closed: The free quota is closed for now.
start.pay.quota.budget: Your budget for this month is used up.
start.pay.quota.site-budget: The site's budget for this month is used up.
start.pay.quota.not-accepted: The free quota is for authors whose application was accepted.
import.title: Import a plugin
import.text: A plugin's folder or a ZIP of it: what the workshop gives as downloads, or a plugin's source (such as a ZIP of its repository). It becomes a new project here, with its files and pictures.
import.done.code: Imported {name}, a plugin with code: {n} files.
import.large: The ZIP is larger than {mb} MB.
import.fetch: The store did not give the plugin (it answered {status}).
workshop.network.real: Plugins may reach the internet (on this computer only)
steps.list_files: Looked at the plugin's files ({n} times)
steps.set_fixtures: Recorded answers for its requests ({n} times)
step.control.widget: Put it on the home screen
steps.control.widget: Put it on the home screen ({n} times)
